mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Moparts thread titled as a King bearings problem. The search snippet did not show the specific fault or the thread date, so nothing beyond the title is confirmed here - flagged for a look rather than reported as a known defect.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: recent-production King main thrust bearings reported out of spec, with the poster citing King technical support as saying they would not personally use them. Free-spread concern: thrust bearings said to slip onto main caps and block grooves too easily.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on a BMW forum claiming King rod bearings shipped with incorrect sizes mixed into standard-labelled boxes. Framed as a pre-install check-everything warning rather than a single bad set.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW owner reports King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, and says the problem repeated across more than one block. Credible single-source dimensional defect claim.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder reports a King SI main bearing shell malformed in production - crushed and twisted so it would not sit on the journal - plus bearing shaving material and oil found inside the shrink wrap. Poster says he has sworn off the brand.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.nastyz28.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint is about service as much as product: an unopened King XP box reported to contain a mixed set of thicknesses (one .030 lower among .011 parts), and the title asserts King gave no professional help resolving it.
